summary: Ulixe Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned Italian subsidiary, Ulixe Italy S.r.l., sold 100% of Ulixe Nova S.r.l. to Condotti Capital S.r.l. for nominal consideration of €1.00, plus a post-closing receivable/payable reconciliation within 90 days. The board approved the divestiture after considering strategic priorities for a planned Nasdaq uplisting, Ulixe Nova’s financial condition, capital needs, and administrative burden. No premium, advisor, or breakup fee was disclosed. The deal closed on June 18, 2026. Watch for Nasdaq uplisting progress and Ulixe Nova's recapitalization, though risk-arb is minimal given nominal consideration.
